params.name: build_id
params.description: To filter sessions of specific build.

params.name: username
params.description: To filter sessions of specific user.

params.name: test_name
params.description: To filter sessions of specific test name.

params.name: offset
params.description: It defines the number of lists on the basis of limit parameter. e.g offset=10

params.name: limit
params.description: To fetch specified number of records. e.g. limit=10

params.name: status
params.description: To fetch the list of sessions with specific statuses. You can pass multiple comma seperated statuses e.g. running,queued,completed,passed,failed,timeout,error and lambda-error.

params.name: fromdate
params.description: To fetch the list of sessions that executed from the specified Start Date. The Date format must be YYYY-MM-DD. e.g. "2018-03-15".

params.name: todate
params.description: To fetch the list of sessions that executed till the specified End Date. If both fromdate and todate value provided then it works as range filter. The Date format must be YYYY-MM-DD. e.g. "2018-03-15".

params.name: sort
params.description: To sort the list in ascending or descending order using multiple keys. e.g. "asc.user_id,desc.duration"

params.name: tags
params.description: To filter basis on test tags. e.g. "testTag1,testTag2,testTag3"

items.docs: To fetch list of sessions. You can also limit the number of records, and paginate through your data using Parameters.

info.name: command logs of a test session

params.name: session_id
params.description: Session ID

params.name: annotationId
params.description: Annotation ID (slug) to fetch command logs for a specific annotation. Take this value from the `annotationId` field of a placeholder entry in the full command log response (e.g. `open-homepage_1`). When provided, returns only the command logs for that annotation on the requested page.

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: Page number of the annotation command log to fetch. Only used when `annotationId` is set. Defaults to 1. Annotations spanning multiple pages require separate calls per page.

items.docs: To fetch the all executed commands of a test session in plain json text. Optionally pass annotationId to fetch annotation-specific command logs.
